title: Healthy adult reference values (synthetic, from clinical chemistry consensus)
journal_year: Tietz Textbook of Clinical Chemistry and Molecular Diagnostics, 5th ed (2012); Harrison's 21st ed reference ranges
diagnosis_quote: Reference range mid-values for healthy adult population, age 20-60

peak_body_temperature.source_quote: normal core body temperature ~36.5-37.0°C, AAFP/Mayo Clinic

log10_serum_ferritin.source_quote: adult serum ferritin reference 30-300 ng/mL, median ~100 (Tietz)

glycosylated_ferritin_fraction.source_quote: healthy adults glycosylated ferritin >50% (Fautrel reference); typical median ~60-70%

CRP.source_quote: healthy adult hsCRP <3 mg/L = low cardiovascular risk (AHA), median ~1 mg/L

log10_serum_IL18.source_quote: healthy adult serum IL-18 ~50-150 pg/mL (multiple ELISA reference studies), median ~80

extraction_method: consensus reference range, no specific PMC case
notes: Synthetic healthy adult reference. Used for v5 PoC validation: expected log10 LR << 0 (far from AOSD).
